store.label: 24/7 Store Robbery
store.subtitle: STORE HOLDUP
store.description: A contract for exactly three players. Once started, go to any store in the city, threaten the clerk with a weapon until he gives up, empty the registers and find the back safe. The safe has a 3-digit code and a unique hint.
briefing: Start the contract with a crew of exactly 3 players.
Go to any 24/7 / LTD / Liquor store in the city.
Aim a weapon at the clerk until he raises his hands.
Once he surrenders you can rob the registers and shelves.
Go to the back safe and get a hint for the 3-digit code.
Enter the code on the keypad and collect the loot.

atm.label: ATM Breach
atm.subtitle: ATM HIT
atm.description: You have 10 minutes to reach any ATM in the city and pick one of three methods: drill, explosive, or ripping it out with a rope and a vehicle.
briefing: Start the ATM contract at the NPC.
Find any ATM in the city.
ALT on the ATM and pick: drill / bomb / rope and vehicle.
The rope method needs a vehicle nearby.
Finish before the 10-minute timer runs out.

house.label: Luxury House Break-in
house.subtitle: LUXURY HOUSE
house.description: Break into a rich home in Vinewood. After starting at the contact, drive to the marked target and break into the loot point.
briefing: Drive to the house marked on the GPS.
Use third eye at the target point.
Finish the break-in and collect the loot.

container.label: Port Container Robbery
container.subtitle: PORT CONTAINER
container.description: A valuable shipment is waiting at the port. Start at the contact, drive to the port and open the marked container.
briefing: Get the job from the NPC.
Drive to the container at the port.
Use third eye at the container point.
Open it and collect the goods.
